text: In a bamboo grove in feudal Japan, Yone and her daughter-in-law Shige are [raped and murdered by a troop of samurai|wrong|sexual violation], and a black cat licks at their bodies. They [return as ghosts in the guise of fine ladies|origin|the wronged dead return], luring samurai to an illusory mansion and tearing their throats like cats. When the young samurai Gintoki is sent to destroy them, he finds his own mother and wife, bound by [a pact with the underworld|origin|bargains with dark powers] that [demands his death too|rules|everything has a price].
